To determine which horror movie set in 1972 Vietnam features Bokor Hill Station, we focus on the relevant information:

- **R-Point**: This is a 2004 Korean horror film set in 1972 Vietnam, during the Vietnam War. It stars Kam Woo-sung and Son Byong-ho as members of the South Korean military in Vietnam. Most of the movie was shot in Cambodia, and Bokor Hill Station plays a prominent part of the movie, doubling as a colonial French plantation.

- **City of Ghosts**: This is a 2002 drama film co-written, directed by, and starring Matt Dillon. It was made in Cambodia, including locations like Phnom Penh and Bokor Hill Station, but it is not set in 1972 Vietnam.

From this, we can conclude that the horror movie set in 1972 Vietnam and filmed in part at Bokor Hill Station is "R-Point."

FINDING: R-Point is the horror movie set in 1972 Vietnam and filmed in part at Bokor Hill Station.
